# /hunt:schedule

ARGUMENTS = what the user wrote with this request (<day, e.g. tomorrow, wed, 2026-11-20>); empty if nothing. Skills named below are this plugin's skills (`hunt:<name>` in Codex), tools are the tools of its MCP servers (hunt, hunt-telegram, hunt-browser, hunt-bridge).

Use skill `hunt` → step 7. Resolve "ARGUMENTS" to a date with `time_info`. Only listings with decision `want_view`. Order by route, propose slots to owners (drafts), confirm, `viewing_set`, then `day_plan_post`.
